name: mitogen-activated protein kinase kinase kinase 7
pathways: positive regulation of JUN kinase activity

function.text: MAP3K7 encodes mitogen-activated protein kinase kinase kinase 7. Annotated molecular activities include kinase activity and MAP kinase activity. It participates in positive regulation of JUN kinase activity and canonical NF-kappaB signal transduction.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to cardiospondylocarpofacial syndrome (autosomal dominant); frontometaphyseal dysplasia 2 (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; strong GenCC assertion from Ambry Genetics. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
